title: The agent takes one step past its budget
concept: A budget guard that checks AFTER spending, or with the wrong comparison, always overspends by one step -- and the trace says it stopped on budget.
skill: You can read a stop condition and say whether it fires before or after the step it is meant to prevent.
deeper: labs/L11-replayable-trace/brief.md -- why the trace has to record WHICH condition stopped the loop
